identify: The plant is small and the leaves roll downward and crinkle.
New leaves show some yellow colour and later they curl.
The whitefly carries this virus from plant to plant.
damage: Older leaves become leathery and brittle. The plant is pale and bushy.

cultural: Raise the nursery under a net with a fine mesh so that the whitefly cannot enter.
